text: A light-year measures distance, not time - it is the distance light travels in one year.
Saturn rings are made mostly of ice and rock chunks orbiting the planet.
A black hole is a region where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape.
The Sun is a medium-sized star at the center of our solar system, about 150 million kilometers from Earth.
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system with more than 80 known moons.
Searing meat does not seal in juices - the crust forms from the Maillard browning reaction.
Pasta water should be salted heavily so the pasta absorbs flavor as it cooks.
Yeast leavens bread by converting sugars into carbon dioxide gas and ethanol.
Tomatoes are botanically fruits but are used as vegetables in savory cooking.
A roux is a mixture of equal parts flour and fat used to thicken sauces and soups.
A marathon is a long-distance race covering exactly 42.195 kilometers.
In basketball, a free throw is worth one point and is awarded after certain fouls.
The offside rule in soccer prevents attackers from staying goal-side of the last defender.
Tennis grand slam matches are played to the best of three or five sets.
A hat-trick in hockey or soccer means a player scores three goals in a single game.
A major chord is built from the root, major third, and perfect fifth notes of a scale.
A standard piano has 88 keys spanning seven octaves plus a minor third.
Tempo in music is measured in beats per minute, often abbreviated as BPM.
A symphony is a long-form musical composition for orchestra, usually in four movements.
Vinyl records store audio as physical grooves that a needle vibrates to reproduce sound.
The printing press, invented by Gutenberg around 1440, made books widely affordable.
The Roman Empire fell in 476 AD when the last western emperor was deposed.
The Magna Carta, signed in 1215, limited the power of the English king.
World War II ended in 1945 after the surrender of Japan and Germany.
The Berlin Wall, separating East and West Berlin, stood from 1961 until 1989.
